# Foundation & Crawlspace Directory (foundationcrawlspace.online)

> Independent California contractor directory and homeowner cost guide for foundation repair, house leveling, crawlspace encapsulation, vapor barriers, and French drain waterproofing across 11 Greater Sacramento, Placer County, and El Dorado County cities (91 public contractor profiles).

## Buying & Cost Guides (PAA + PASF Answers)
- [Foundation Repair Greater Sacramento: Methods & Cost Guide](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/foundation-repair/): How to tell if your Sacramento, Roseville, or Folsom foundation needs piers, helical vs. push pier costs, insurance rules, and how to vet CSLB contractors.
- [House Leveling Sacramento: Slab & Pier-and-Beam Cost Guide](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/house-leveling/): What house leveling costs in Sacramento, Folsom, and Auburn, pier-and-beam shimming vs. slab foam lifting, pipe protection during lifts, and vetting quotes.
- [Crawlspace Encapsulation Sacramento: Moisture Barriers & 2026 Costs](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/crawlspace-encapsulation/): Crawlspace encapsulation costs in Sacramento, Folsom, and Auburn, 20-mil vapor barriers vs. basic plastic, downsides, tax credit rules, and local pros.
- [French Drain Installation Sacramento: Yard Drainage Costs & Pros](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/drainage-french-drains/): What French drain installation costs in Sacramento, Roseville, and El Dorado Hills (100 ft, 200 ft & 300 ft runs), downsides, and CSLB-vetted drainage contractors.

## Key Local Cost & Repair Facts
- **Foundation Pier Underpinning Cost (Sacramento)**: $1,600 to $3,000 per push pier or helical pier; most residential structural projects run $6,500 to $22,000.
- **Pier-and-Beam House Leveling Cost**: $2,500 to $6,500 for accessible crawlspace re-shimming and adjustable steel posts; full deep-pier slab lifting runs $8,000 to $25,000+.
- **Polyurethane Foam Slab Lifting**: $1,500 to $4,500 for settled interior slab pockets, driveways, or garages.
- **Homeowners Insurance Rule**: Standard California policies exclude clay-soil movement; coverage applies only when a sudden plumbing break under the slab washes out support soil.
